column1: # Ash Jenna, an antagonist, confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
There you are, Isaac. I've
been watching Tolbi's
harbor for three nights.{page_break}Do you know what the
fishermen keep pulling
out of the water?{end_wait}
That's Jenna's face, but\nshe's Menardi's prisoner.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

Who am I? I'm a Jenna who
stopped waiting to be
saved.{page_break}The fire is leaving me,
and what's left is cold.
It never forgets.{end_wait}
You wear her face, but\nJenna would never talk\nlike this!{end_wait}

No, she wouldn't. She also
wouldn't have lasted this
long.{page_break}Be quiet, Garet. You're
making a scene.{end_wait}
That isn't your Jenna.\nIt only wears her face, so\nlet the harbor have it.{end_wait}

Mia, you hear it too, don't
you? The voice in that
blade.{page_break}It's the same hunger that
woke in me.{end_wait}

Light the next lighthouse,
Isaac. More will wake, and
Tolbi will drown them all.{page_break}Or you can be kind and
end it quickly. I'll be
watching either way.{end_wait}
